headline: FTISLAND take 'FTSODE' to 3 Asian cities in January
sub: Taipei sold out on opening, adding one more show
caption:
FTISLAND are taking their 'FTSODE' concert series across Asia this January.

The 2027 FTISLAND CONCERT 'FTSODE' heads to Macau (Jan 9), Taipei (Jan 16–17) and Tokyo (Jan 20–21). Taipei sold out as soon as tickets opened, so one more show has been added. The Seoul shows of the series are also sold out. 'FTSODE', now in its 4th year, blends FTISLAND and "episode".

📌 Source: FNC Entertainment, via Korean media
